Laminated Long Brown Wood Planks
(Wood 0066)
These are laminated long wood floor tiles.

This type of dark coloured planks is commonly used in interior design.

Version 1.01: Fixed gap issue
Cross Section of Wood Log Texture
(Wood 0065)
It is the cross-section of a tree trunk or the tree grain patterns found on tree stumps.

If you are creating a large tree log, this texture may help you fill the ends of your timber.
Waxy Tree Trunk Bark Texture
(Wood 0064)
It is a waxy tree trunk. Therefore, its bark has a layer of glossy coating.

If you are building a forest, this texture may increase your tree variations.
